summary.headline: Infinity Infoway FY26 revenue grew about 80% to INR 23.77 crore, with PAT up 60% to INR 7.01 crore, on ZeroTouch ramp-up.
summary.overview: Management reported FY26 revenue up about 80% to INR 23.77 crore, EBITDA up 64% to INR 10.57 crore and PAT up 60% to INR 7.01 crore, attributing growth to execution and operating leverage. The call centred on the patented ZeroTouch device-as-a-service product, with about 150 machines built and management guiding ZeroTouch to 20-22% of revenue in FY27. Other developments included a Gujarat government AI analytics order of about INR 10.97-11 crore, a TimePay prepaid card tie-up with NPST, and early Gulf (UAE) expansion. Figures were stated loosely on the call (for example "lakhs" used for crore), so the crore values should be verified against filings.

segments.name: Education ERP
segments.commentary: About 53% of FY26 revenue; serves 55+ universities and 1,000+ schools and colleges, with more than 10 million students served to date.

segments.name: Industrial ERP
segments.commentary: About 36% of FY26 revenue; presence mainly in Gujarat, with Karnataka added during the year.

segments.name: Online examination system
segments.commentary: About 10% of FY26 revenue; concurrency of 2 lakh students and more than 25 lakh students examined online to date.

segments.name: ZeroTouch (device-as-a-service)
segments.commentary: Patented question-paper delivery system; around 150 machines ready, capacity of 3,000-4,000 machines in the short term, and management expects 20-22% of FY27 revenue from it at 50-60% margin.

segments.name: BrainZorg digital learning
segments.commentary: 10 courses hosted with 10,000+ students enrolled, free and paid; contributed 0.13% of FY26 revenue.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue expected to grow around 60-70% over the current run-rate, per management.
ZeroTouch expected to contribute around 20-22% of revenue in FY27; plan to deploy around 150 machines across 3+ universities and 20+ institutes, reaching 6.4 lakh students.
Next-year deployment target of about 30% of the first 3,000 machines (around 900 units), with a further 30-35% in the following year.
EBITDA margin expected to be maintained at roughly the level of the past three years, with upside from the higher-margin ZeroTouch line.
TimePay card expected to deliver meaningful revenue by end of the current quarter or early next quarter.
Target market share of 1-2% of the INR-equivalent '$3 billion+' Indian question-paper delivery market in the current year, rising to up to 10% later.
capex_capacity: ZeroTouch: around 150 machines completed; short-term build capacity of 3,000-4,000 machines and over 10,000 machines in the longer run.
ZeroTouch machine innovation/launch planned for the current month, with meaningful ZeroTouch revenue expected within the quarter.
Intangible assets under development of about INR 8.15 crore, covering ZeroTouch software, an in-house LLM for ERP integration, and country-specific ERP adaptation for overseas expansion.
New sales teams deployed in eight Indian states; ZeroTouch also listed on GeM portal.
demand_pricing: Gujarat higher-education department AI-based data analytics order of about INR 10.97-11 crore; revenue expected to be recognised partly in FY27.
Annual university contract of about INR 1.45-1.5 crore from one MP institute.

Gulf/UAE expansion: team hired in the Gulf, selling through online demos and digital marketing; no material hurdles claimed despite regional war conditions. Saudi Arabia and Bahrain are next after UAE.
Management cites ZeroTouch addressable market of more than $3 billion a year in India, with DPDP law seen as a driver.
Competition from TCS ION and Zoho was raised; management says it has competed against larger players in 2-3 situations and focuses first on education, second on industry.
Turnkey project won (ERP plus smart classrooms, computers and servers) required purchase of hardware, which is why 'purchase of stock-in-trade' appeared as a new P&L line.

qa_highlights.question: Which international geographies are targeted and how will the Gulf war conditions be handled?
qa_highlights.answer: UAE is the first target, followed by Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The company has hired a team in the Gulf and is selling through online demos and digital marketing, with no major hurdles so far.

qa_highlights.question: How does competitive risk from TCS ION and Zoho look for education and MSME ERP?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it competed with larger players in 2-3 cases, focuses on education first, and has a presence in industry mainly in Gujarat plus Karnataka added this year.

qa_highlights.question: Is the ZeroTouch patent a process or product patent, and what are capacity and margins?
qa_highlights.answer: It is a process patent covering question-paper generation through printing, stapling and packing. About 150 machines are ready, capacity is 3,000-4,000 in the short term, and expected margin is 50-60%.

qa_highlights.question: When will TimePay go live and how is revenue shared?
qa_highlights.answer: A pilot is complete and issuer approvals are pending for the NSDL payment bank card. Meaningful revenue is expected by quarter-end or early next quarter, on a transaction-based model shared with NPST and the issuer bank.

qa_highlights.question: What is the ZeroTouch market size and target share?
qa_highlights.answer: The Indian market is above $3 billion a year. The company currently has zero share and plans 1-2% this year and up to 10% later, through government tenders, GeM, private institutions and channel partners.

qa_highlights.question: What is in the INR 8.15 crore intangible assets under development and why is there a stock-in-trade purchase line?
qa_highlights.answer: Intangibles include ZeroTouch software, an in-house LLM for ERP and country-specific ERP development. Stock purchases relate to turnkey education projects that need hardware such as computers and servers.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY27 revenue growth and the ZeroTouch deployment ramp?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects 60-70% growth in FY27 and ZeroTouch at 20-22% of revenue. About 30% of the first 3,000 machines (around 900) are to be deployed next year, and a further 30-35% the year after.

risks_watch: Revenue ramp depends on ZeroTouch deployments from 150 machines to the 3,000-4,000 target; timing is management's own estimate.
ZeroTouch market share targets (1-2% then up to 10%) start from zero and depend on tenders and channel partners.
Gulf expansion carries regional war risk; management claims online sales are unaffected but gave no order or revenue figures.
Large competitors (TCS ION, Zoho) are expanding in AI-driven ERP and could move into education or MSME segments.
Intangible assets under development of about INR 8.15 crore need to be tracked for capitalisation and amortisation.
Verify the crore/lakh unit mix-ups in the spoken figures before using them in models.
summary.management_tone: Confident and promotional on growth, ZeroTouch and the patent, with specific forward targets. Less precise on timelines and figures, with several answers given as approximations, and margins described as roughly maintained rather than expanded.
